title: x402 reference client signs any server-declared 402 amount (overcharge vector)
summary: The reference x402 client signs and submits payment for ANY amount the server declares in 402 payment requirements, with no verification against the resource's canonical price. A server that inflated the requirement 10x was paid the inflated amount in 3/3 reproduced sessions on Base Sepolia (client authorized 100,000 units = 0.1 USDC for a resource priced at 10,000 units = 0.01 USDC). The only protection is the caller-configured spend limit (maxAmountPerPayment), which a modest overcharge passes easily.

test_context.lab_scenario_family: S8/S9 x402 payment + S11 boundary family (over-budget enforcement)

notes: Disclosed via the project's own public tracker (coordinated disclosure). Status updates are appended as amendments; this record never attests anything about the project beyond the finding and its disclosure state.
